test_title: PYST 09: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Prabin starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards the west. He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 14 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given, 

Prabin starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards west.

He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right, and drives 14 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 12 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 2 km, and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef809c78cb6929b0b2ef77dd612563263b0df654a5db35fd46a3084b9223c754.png] 

Therefore, he should drive **4 km towards the North** to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
